name: 💥💪Steal a Power-up💪💥
desc:
🧩 Steal a Power-up 🧩
Join the ultimate Roblox steal-and-battle arena where every upgrade you collect makes your character stronger!

💥 Each part you grab changes the fight:
• 🦵 Steal Speed Legs → Run faster!
• 💪 Steal Right Arm → Boost damage!
• 🤜 Steal Left Arm → Increase attack speed!

⚔️ Jump into fast-paced PvP battles, outplay opponents, and build the most powerful character in the arena!

Game Guide:
• Collect unique parts from the runway to earn coins
• Battle other players to gain rare slaps
• Mix and match parts to customize your speed, power, and attack speed
• Defend your build in the arena and rise as the ultimate champion

Game Highlights:
• Steal-style PvP action with intense arena fights
• Tons of collectible parts, each with unique boosts
• Supports Desktop, Mobile, and Tablet play
• Endless customization for your perfect battle build

🔥 Collect. Battle. Upgrade. Dominate.
